# Debrief: Argo CD, Prometheus

These clips cover Argo CD practices: avoiding imperative app creation outside Git, fast PR previews using a real Argo CD instance, and using the Argo CD API for troubleshooting, with only passing mention of Prometheus. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. A GitOps anti-pattern is a custom CLI that pulls config from an existing database, generates Argo CD application manifests on the fly, and applies them to Argo CD without storing anything in Git. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s))
2. Running a real Argo CD instance to render PR previews gives accurate diffs matching production configuration. One team reports about 5 seconds for roughly 1,000 applications using self-hosted runners. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))
3. The Argo CD API can expose application logs, Kubernetes events, and live versus desired state, which helps troubleshooting and reduces data silos across tools such as Prometheus metrics backends. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit how Argo CD applications get created in your organization, and check whether any scripts or CLIs apply generated manifests to Argo CD without committing them to Git. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s))
- [ ] Try rendering pull request previews with a real Argo CD instance, limiting rendering to only the applications and clusters affected by a change to keep runs fast. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
- [ ] Evaluate a namespace-scoped, slimmed-down Argo CD install by removing cluster roles and unneeded components, as one team does in production. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))

## Watch together (8 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s) (1:19), Regina Voloshin: Names an imperative anti-pattern that bypasses Git in Argo CD setups.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Shows lockdown-mode Argo CD and 5-second PR previews at 1,000 apps.
3. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Explains narrowing render scope to changed applications and clusters.
4. [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s) (2:27), Alexander Matyushentsev, Leonardo Luz Almeida: Shows Argo CD API as a troubleshooting data source across silos.
5. [From FTP To Argo CD & Argo Rollouts: An Adoption History Inside a Corp · 12:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wrek7kjrcs0&t=737s) (1:19), Alfonso Ming, Meritxell Rodríguez: Explains declarative GitOps and drift correction with Argo CD.
